{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Final check: ensure each patient_id appears exactly once in cleaned data
df_clean = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Keep only the row with highest sample_seq per patient
df_clean = df_clean.loc[df_clean.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Verify no duplicates in patient_id
assert df_clean['patient_id'].nunique() == len(df_clean), "Duplicates remain in patient_id after deduplication"

# Final count of enrolled patients
enrolled_patients = len(df_clean)
print(enrolled_patients)"}
